Even combine Old + Beard + Fat effects when you also have Oldify, Beardify or Fatify installed on your device!

MAKE BALD FRIENDS!
It's hilarious :)

Join us: @apptly on Instagram / Twitter


Go bald with style.

name: AmpliTube
description:
Quer o mais avançado estúdio mobile de timbres para guitarra e baixo?

AmpliTube dá a você uma coleção imensa de equipamentos virtuais que você pode usar para praticar, tocar e gravar com sons de categoria internacional em qualquer lugar ou momento.

Monte seu próprio equipamento de guitarra ou baixo com até 6 pedais de efeito, um amplificador com gabinete e microfones. Conecte seu instrumento ao seu iPhone com uma interface IK como iRig 2 ou iRig HD 2, e prepare-se para arrebentar.

AmpliTube para iPhone dá a você 17 pedais de efeitos, 8 amplificadores, 10 gabinetes de falantes e 2 microfones, um pacote grátis de grooves de Rock para o Loop Drummer e um gravador de 2 pistas. 

Você pode expandir isto com uma biblioteca imensa de cerca de 150 amplificadores e pedais das maiores marcas como Fender™, Ampeg®, Orange®, Mesa/Boogie®, e muitos outros, ou libere os equipamentos dos seus heróis como Joe Satriani, Dimebag Darrell e agora Brian May.

Pronto para subir ao palco? O Modo Live do AmpliTube oferece uma interface otimizada para utilização ao vivo, com todos os controles e configurações que você precisa em formato fácil de ler.

Controle seu equipamento virtual como um equipamento real: troque programas, acione efeitos, loops e mais, tudo com os pés. AmpliTube se conecta ao iRig Stomp I/O em um poderoso equipamento de palco tudo-em-um, funciona sem fio com a iRig BlueBoard e também suporta outros controladores MIDI.

AmpliTube também oferece maneiras inovadoras de tocar, praticar e gravar com um Looper opcional, mais loops de bateria, um gravador e estúdio em estilo DAW completo de 8 pistas, todos disponíveis para compra in-app.

Seja em casa, no estúdio ou no palco, AmpliTube é o equipamento dos sonhos que você sempre desejou, em um dispositivo que está sempre com você!

Recursos do AmpliTube:

- Monte equipamentos de guitarra e baixo com até 6 pedais, 1 amplificador e 1 gabinete com 2 microfones.
- Inclui 17 pedais, 8 amplificadores, 10 gabinetes e 2 microfones
- Expandível com quase 150 modelos de equipamentos disponíveis da Fender™, Ampeg®, Orange®, Mesa/Boogie®, Joe Satriani, Dimebag Darrell e agora Brian May
- Modo Live mostra seu equipamento completo de forma simples, com todos os parâmetros que você precisa no palco facilmente acessíveis
- Inclui gravador de 2 pistas (compra in-app libera até 8 pistas)
- Modo Studio para edição intuitiva em estilo DAW (libere via compra in-app)
- Módulo Loop Drummer toca em sincronia com o gravador
- Inclui speed trainer, metrônomo e afinador
- Suporte a Inter-App Audio e AudioBus
- Compartilhamento de projeto entre versões e dispositivos
- Importe e toque músicas como backing tracks a partir de sua Music Library ou computador
- Exporte áudio via E-mail, SoundCloud ou File Sharing
- Controlável via MIDI e com integração embutida para iRig Stomp I/O, iRig BlueBoard e outros controladores
- Baixa latência para tocar em tempo real

Mais informações:
www.amplitube.com/ios
Accessory info:
www.ikmultimedia.com/irig

name: Photo EKG
description:
Hoje em dia é comum médicos e profissionais da área de saúde trocarem fotos de ECG através de tablets e smartphones, seja por e-mail ou mensagens. No entanto, visualizar e fazer medidas nos traçados em telas eletrônicas pode não ser tão fácil ou efetivo como em um ECG impresso. Photo EKG, além de permitir a criação de uma coleção de imagens de eletrocardiogramas, traz a facilidade de medições através de compasso eletrônico.

Características:
-Coleção de imagens
-Compasso eletrônico
-Medidas de duração e amplitude
-Cálculo de frequência cardíaca, QT corrigido e eixo do QRS
-Referência rápida de eletrocardiografia

Dr. Hugo Ramadan
Dra. Carla Almeida

name: EP Mobile
description:
EP Mobile provides tools for cardiac electrophysiologists, cardiologists, cardiology fellows, internists, emergency room physicians, medical students, nurses, technicians, and other health care workers who deal with cardiac arrhythmias.

If you have suggestions, features you'd like to see, or complaints, please email us! 

EP Mobile -- The Swiss Army Knife of Electrophysiology!

Features:
- All modules fully referenced with links to articles
- Copy results to clipboard to paste into other apps
- Below is a limited list of modules, more modules are added frequently
- Pacing maneuvers: para-Hisian pacing and RV apex vs base pacing
- Heart rhythm drugs and anticoagulants reference: dabigatran, dofetilide, rivaroxaban, sotalol, apixaban, edoxaban
- Creatinine clearance calculator
- Warfarin clinic utility
- Interval to rate conversion
- QTc calculator (Bazett, Fridericia, Sagie and Hodges formulas)
- Additional QTc calculators for IVCD
- QT prolongation risk score
- Date calculator
- Atrial fibrillation risk scores (CHADS2, CHA2DS2-VASc, ATRIA scores)
- Bleeding risk scores (HAS-BLED, HEMORR2HAGES, SAMe-TT2R2, ORBIT)
- Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy SCD risk scores (2002, 2014, 2022, 2024)
- ICD implantation risk score
- ICD mortality risk score
- Syncope risk scores (EGSYS, Martin, OESIL, SF)
- CMS (Medicare) ICD guidelines calculator, now updated to new 2018 criteria
- Atrial tachycardia location algorithm
- VT localization algorithms
- Epicardial vs endocardial VT
- Outflow tract VT
- Mitral annular VT
- Entrainment mapping
- WPW accessory pathway location (Arruda, Modified Arruda, D'Avila, Milstein and others)
- Long QT diagnosis, subtypes, and ECG patterns
- Short QT syndrome diagnosis
- Brugada syndrome diagnosis
- Early Repolarization syndrome diagnosis
- LVH ECG criteria, including Romhilt-Estes score and others
- RVH ECG criteria
- True LBBB criteria
- ARVC/D 1994 and 2010 diagnostic criteria
- ARVC/D risk calculator
- Normal EP values
- Wide complex tachycardia diagnosis

name: iComics
description:
iComics® is a Universal app designed for iPad, iPhone and iPod touch that allows you to read DRM-free comics from your own collection, quickly and smoothly!   

Supporting all of the major comic formats, iComics makes it extremely easy to import comic files onto your iOS device and start reading them straight away!   

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

Features   

* Supports all of the major comic formats (ZIP, CBZ, RAR, CBR, 7ZIP, CB7, TAR, CBT, LZH, LHA, EPUB, PDF).  
* Collections for organizing sets of comics.
* Hot jumping directly from one comic to the next.
* Super smooth scrolling when turning pages. 
* Comics can be imported from your PC via iTunes, or from other apps on your iOS device (Such as Dropbox, or Safari).  
* Comic files are never modified or destroyed (So you can get them back off your device whenever you want!)   
* A slider that lets you jump between comic pages quickly.  
* Comics can be read from left-to-right, or right-to-left (Great for Eastern comics)  
* Page zooming can be set to reset every time a page is turned, or locked to the same scale across all pages.  
* Extra wide comic pages can be split up and treated as two separate pages.  
* Many sharing settings including being able to email, print or locally save individual pages!   

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-   

System Requirements   

iComics requires iOS 12.0 or higher   

Supported hardware includes:  
* iPad (iPad Air and above)  
* iPhone (iPhone 6 and above)  
* iPod touch (6th Generation and above)

name: Os Elementos por Theodore Gray
description:
The Elements baseia-se na edição de capa dura do best-selle internacional The Elements, de Theodore Gray, colunista responsável pela "Gray Matter" da revista Popular Science Magazine. Mas ele vai muito além do que é possível no papel.

De todos os aplicativos de tabela periódica, só existe um que Stephen Fry descreveu como "Sozinho já vale o preço de um iPad!". Os Elementos: Uma Exploração Visual não é um aplicativo de referência; é uma história de amor à tabela períodoca, rica e envolvente, contada em palavras e imagens, e que permite vivenciar a beleza e fascinação dos blocos de construção do nosso universo de uma maneira que você nunca viu antes.

Você começa com uma tabela periódica, onde cada elemento é exibido com uma amostra que gira fluidamente. Para ler sobre latão, toque no soldado. Para ler sobre ouro, toque na pepita. Imediatamente você verá a amostra preenchendo quase toda a tela, fotografada com extrema precisão e girando em torno de um círculo completo na frente dos seus olhos. Ao lado disso, uma coluna com fatos e estatísticas, que ao serem tocados trazem riqueza de detalhes e informações atuais através do mecanismo de conhecimento computacional Wolfram|Alpha.

Acesse a segunda página de cada elemento para encontrar uma história fascinante sobre o elemento, cercada por objetos fotografados minuciosamente para representá-lo. Cada um destes objetos, mais de 500 no total, é um objeto vivo que pode ser girado livremente de todos os lados e aproximado para a visualização de detalhes sem precedentes.

Toque no nome do elemento no topo da págima para ver o nome desse elemento em mais de doze idiomas. Os Elementos inclui o texto completo original em inglês e o livro inteiro com histórias, legendas e todo o restante em mais de uma dezena de traduções completas.

Aplique zoom com os dedos ou toque em qualquer objeto para colocá-lo em tela cheia, onde você pode dividi-lo em um par de imagens 3D estéreo. Usando óculos 3D de baixo custo, você pode ver os 500 objetos saírem da tela em 3D e pode girá-los, em 3D, com o toque de um dedo. Não tem como ser mais virtualmente real do que isso.

Se você teve uma má experiência nas aulas de química na escola, este livro é o antídoto. Se você ou algum conhecido acha que química é a matéria mais chata de todas, este livro irá mostrar que a tabela periódica é muito mais do que um monte de números e letras.

------------

Resenhas:

“O esplendor e poder do iPad podem ser demonstrados ao máximo com Os Elementos... é diferente de qualquer outro ebook que você já viu. A tabela periódica dos elementos ganha vida."
– USA Today

“É deslumbrante; Faz a ciência parecer mágica em suas mãos.”
– Xeni Jardin, Boing Boing

------------

O conjunto completo de recursos inclui:

• Mais de 500 objetos giráveis fotografados da maneira incrível, em alta resolução
• Informações atuais e detalhadas do Wolfram|Alpha
• Páginas caprichosamente montadas para cada Elemento da tabela periódica
• Histórias divertidas e fatos fascinantes
• Aplique zoom com os dedos para ver detalhes incríveis de todos os objetos e gire em 3D
• Apresentação cativante explicando a estrutura da tabela periódica
• Totalmente traduzido em: Português, Alemão, Catalão, Chinês simplificado, Coreano, Crota, Espanhol, Finlandês, Francês, Holandês, Inglês, Italiano, Japonês, Polonês, Russa, Sueco, Turco

------------

Sobre o autor:

Theodore Gray é um autor de best-sellers e colaborador da revista Popular Science Magazine com a coluna Gray Matter desde 2003.

------------

name: My Lift: Measure your strength
description:
****Designed by sport scientists, trusted by elite athletes****
****Validated in the prestigious Journal of Sports Sciences****

What is your maximal strength? Which weight should you use in your next training session to optimize results? My Lift is the first scientifically designed app to measure your 1-Repetition Maximum (1-RM) in the most accurate way possible. 

Knowing your 1-RM in every single training session is essential to adjust your training intensity and get the best adaptations. However, performing an actual 1-RM test could be dangerous and fatiguing and, if performed every day, it will most likely lead to overtraining or injuries. 

To solve this problem, My Lift uses scientifically validated algorithms that can estimate your 1-RM with high precision by simply recording your exercise. To do this, My Lift uses the high-speed video recording available on most iPhone and iPad devices to measure the velocity at which you are performing the exercise, which is highly correlated with your maximal strength capabilities. This novel approach is used by sport scientists and top-level coaches thanks to advanced instrumental like linear transducers or force platforms, but now you can measure your 1-RM like a pro just with your iPhone or iPad!

My Lift is very intuitive and easy to use: you just need to record one repetition of the desired exercise with 1 to 4 different submaximal loads and select its start and beginning in the app with its accurate frame-by-frame navigation. After that, My Lift will show you your 1-RM! 

Let's say you got a workout which includes 4x5 repetitions at your 80%1-RM. Well, you just need to pick a load and record one repetition with My Lift. It will tell if that load really corresponds to your 80% or not, so you can increase or decrease the weight to train in the right zone!

My Lift has a lot of great features that will help you measure your 1-RM in a very simple, yet powerful way:

-Estimates your 1-Repetition Maximum (1-RM) in a very simple way by measuring your movement velocity, a novel approach used by top sport scientists and elite coaches
-Measures what %1-RM corresponds to a specific load so you can adjust your training and get the best results
-Calculate your movement velocity to monitor your performance!
-Analysis of velocity loss to monitor fatigue.
-Track the trajectory of your lift and measure instantaneous position and velocity
-Works with some of the most widely-used upper and lower body exercises by default: bench-press, deadlift, pull-up, military press, back squat & hip thrust. You can even create your own exercises!
-Multi-team and multi-user: create as many teams and users as you want
-Progress analysis: save as many tests as you want and see your progress through time to check if you have improved or worsened your performance. You can even see the percent of change from one test to another!
-Data export: export your whole database to a csv file and play with your data in Excel!
-iCloud sync (iOS 13+)
-Universal app: purchase once and install it on your iPhone, iPad and Mac (10.15+)

My Lift, train smarter and get the best results!

name: EP Calipers
description: EP Calipers provides electronic calipers to measure intervals on images of electrocardiograms (ECGs) or electrophysiologic recordings.  Doctors, nurses and medical technicians photograph and send ECGs to each other via email and messaging using smart phones and tablets.  It is difficult and inaccurate to make measurements on these images with mechanical calipers.  EP Calipers can be used to make accurate ECG measurements and do calculations such as determining mean heart rate and corrected QT interval.  Angles such as the beta angle in Brugada syndrome can be measured as well.  Analyze ECG images you photograph or store on your device, as well as PDF files, such as ECGs generated by the AliveCor Kardia™ device.

name: Map Chart Mosaic
description:
Offline maps for iPhone, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin or Amazfit smartwatch:
topographic maps, satellite images, GRIB weather forecast maps and road maps with cycle and hiking trails. 
Nautical charts are currently only for USA and Canada available.

Please watch the video and read the FAQ:
http://www.MapChartMosaic.com/

Switch seamlessly between maps from different sources to get detailed information about a location.

Map views are automatically stored in an offline cache on your phone, so that you can view them later without an internet connection.

Download offline maps to Apple Watch or Fitbit smart watch and view them without connection to your phone.

Add map markers and travel routes to the offline maps (e.g. your current car parking location). 
Create map travel routes. Record your GPS Track.
Share map marker, route and track data as GPX files.
Get GPS travel info: speed, course, odometer, route ETA (estimated time of arrival)...

Get GRIB weather forecast maps via Internet download, Email or Iridium Go satellite connection.

You can display the maps also on the Fitbit smart watch. But please don't expect the same maps app performance on the Fitbit as on a phone. The Fitbit is very slow and has very limited space.
The Fitbit phone app "Sync" step, shown in the video, is very important. Don't skip it and make sure that the watch app Map Chart is closed during the Sync.

DISCLAIMER
Do NOT use the app for navigation or any other purpose that may result in personal injury or property damage. Use it at your own risk.

name: Light Pollution Map
description:
The map displays VIIRS/World Atlas/Clouds/Aurora/IAU observatories and the user SQM measurements.

The primary use is to show VIIRS/DMSP data in a friendly manner, but over time it also included some other interesting overlays that concern light pollution like SQM/SQC, World Atlas 2015 zenith brightness, clouds, aurora and IAU observatories. If you have a permanent SQM reader installed you can add it to the map by sending me an e-mail.

Please send comments and requests for new features via email (look under help)

Functionalities:
- VIIRS, Sky Brightness, World Atlas 2015, Cloud coverage and Aurora forecast layers
- VIIRS and Sky Brightness layers can be displayed in color blind friendly colors
- Road & Satellite base maps
- Cloud animation for the last 12 hours
- Get detail radiance and SQM values from layers at a click. For Sky brightness/World Atlas 2015, you also get Bortle class estimation.
- SQM, SQM-L, SQC, SQM-LE, SQM readings submitted by users
- International dark sky parks overlay
- Submit your own SQM (L) readings
- Observatories layer
- Save your favorite locations
- Distance measurement tool with azimuth angle report
- All-sky view of light pollution with real horizon
- Offline mode (Sky brightness map and a base map are saved to your device, so it will be displayed when you are offline)

name: nanoloop
description:
Nanoloop combines sequencer, synthesizer and sampler in one package. It provides all functions for creating electronic music from scratch.

- Easy to use sequencer, suitable for rhythm and melody
- Automatisation of all parameters
- 8 channels, each can be synth or sampler
- 8 patterns per channel
- Sample via microphone
- Re-sample
- Polyphonic FM-, PWM- and noise synth
- Song editor with loop function
- Send and receive projects via e-mail
- WAV export
- Sharing projects and audio in file sharing apps like Dropbox is possible when these apps are installed.
- MIDI sync with other devices
- Ableton Link


The Synth

Nanoloop's FM synth offers a maximum of flexibility within a small set of parameters. It comes with a stereo modulator detune effect and covers the typical clean bells and Rhodes-like sounds, spheric pads, thick beats and basses.


The Sequencer

The stepsequencer visualises the rhythmic structure in a compact 4x4 square matrix, making it very easy to lay out patterns.


The Sampler

Besides A/D envelope, loop function, start offset, tune and fine tune, the puristic sampler comes without effects. You can record up to 6 seconds via microphone or copy samples via iTunes.


Share

With nanoloop for iPhone, you can send your saved projects to other nanoloop users and your own PC via e-mail. If nanoloop is installed on the recipient's iPhone / iPod, she/he can simply tap on the file name in the received e-mail to start nanoloop and import the attached file so that it is available for editing. This makes collaboration very easy, multiple users around the world can work on the same project by simply e-mailing the file.


Export

Songs can be exported to a WAV file that is accessible via iTunes (simply drag & drop files in finder). The exported file is also copied to the clipboard so that it can be pasted in other apps that support pasting audio. If a file sharing app like Dropbox is installed, you can upload the file there.

More information can be found at the nanoloop website: www.nanoloop.com

name: SoundPad
description: SoundPad can record up to 20 custom sounds from your device. These recordings are saved for you but they can also be deleted. This app only requires the use of your microphone. Importing sounds to come!

name: Jazz licks collection
description:
◆Este é um aplicativo de compra única que permite praticar diversas frases de improvisação de jazz com acompanhamento. Compatível com instrumentos transpositores como trompete e saxofone.

【Principais recursos】
・Guia de melodia：As frases são exibidas junto com a partitura e o acompanhamento, facilitando o estudo. Ótimo para iniciantes!
・Acompanhamento com bateria：A bateria marca o ritmo, permitindo que você pratique com atenção ao groove.
・Transposição automática em 12 tons：Pratique sem se preocupar com a tonalidade, mesmo com instrumentos em Dó, Mib ou Sib.
・Tempo ajustável：Altere o tempo conforme necessário nas configurações.
・Ajuste de intervalo de transposição：Otimize o nível de dificuldade transpondo por semitom, quarta justa ou quinta justa.
・Alternância de clave musical：Troque entre clave de sol e clave de fá. O som acompanha automaticamente a mudança.
・Mudança de estilo de acompanhamento：Altere livremente entre swing, bossa nova e outros estilos, conforme o clima.
・Reprodução apenas do acompanhamento：Pratique improvisações como se estivesse em uma apresentação real, sem a melodia.
・Favoritos：Salve suas frases preferidas em um só lugar para acesso rápido.
・Exportação em PDF：Converta frases em partituras PDF para imprimir.
・Interface simples e fácil de usar：Design limpo, sem distrações, para facilitar a navegação.
・Novas frases serão adicionadas：O conteúdo será ampliado com atualizações futuras.

【Recomendado para】
・De iniciantes a músicos avançados de jazz
・Instrumentistas de sopro que desejam melhorar a improvisação em big bands ou jam sessions
・Quem quer aprender frases padrão de forma estruturada
・Quem deseja gerenciar partituras, acompanhamentos e tempo em um único app

【Compra única com tranquilidade】
・Sem taxas adicionais nem assinaturas
・As novas frases também serão adicionadas gratuitamente

name: Jazz ScaleHelper
description:
Choose an exercise: see the notes and hear them played
Play the exercise: get a score, see the notes you played and listen to your performance

Jazz ScaleHelper is the fast way to improve your playing. With actual feedback based on what you played, Jazz ScaleHelper enables you to concentrate on the aspects of your playing that will help the most.

Jazz ScaleHelper has 3 modes:

1. Play any scale: Jazz ScaleHelper determines the exercise you have played and scores your performance. Ideal for impromptu practise sessions.

2. Choose a scale: Choose the exercise you want to play and Jazz ScaleHelper listens and gives you a score. Ideal to improve a specific musical exercise.

3. Challenge me: Jazz ScaleHelper will ask you to play exercises from your challenge list that is based on your chosen syllabus. Jazz ScaleHelper will identify what you need to practise and make sure you get exam ready while having fun on the way. Ideal for practising a range of exercises.

Jazz ScaleHelper contains everything you need for the instruments covered by the Jazz syllabuses from Trinity Guildhall and ABRSM examining boards. Jazz ScaleHelper will be there for you every step of the way as you grow as a musician.

Jazz ScaleHelper allows you to create your own syllabus from the exercises it supports: major scales; dorian modes; lydian modes; lydian flat 7 modes; mixolydian modes; melodic minor scales; jazz melodic minor scales; harmonic minor scales; pentatonic major scales; pentatonic minor scales; blues scales; diminished scales; chromatic scales; whole-tone scales; phrygian modes; locrian modes; altered modes; aeolian modes; major arpeggios; minor arpeggios; augmented arpeggios; major sevenths; minor sevenths; diminished sevenths; half-diminished sevenths; major/minor sevenths; and minor/major sevenths. All exercises are available starting from every tonic over 1 octave, 1 twelfth, 2 octaves, 2.5 octaves and 3 octaves. There is a range of exercise lists for popular music exams available for download. (Jazz ScaleHelper Lite only supports major scales, blues scales and major arpeggios over 1 octave)

Instruments supported include Violin, Viola, Cello, Guitar, Bass Guitar, Clarinet, Flute, Oboe, Saxophone, Bassoon, Recorder, Trumpet, Cornet, Trombone and Horn. A full list is available at www.jazz.ScaleHelper.com along with details of the rich feature set Jazz ScaleHelper has to offer.

At less than the price of a single music lesson the guidance that Jazz ScaleHelper provides between your lessons builds on that teaching. You can dispense with the need to review scales by playing them in your lessons and instead reuse the time you gain to learn technique and perfect your pieces.

Jazz ScaleHelper supports multiple users, keeping each user's history for each of their instruments. You can save recordings to study later or to show and play to your teacher and friends. You can also email recordings to share them with others. Have fun competing with your friends to see who can get the highest score or who can maintain the highest average.

name: cMate-PRO
description:
Если вы из РФ и испытываете проблемы в приобретении приложения, то напишите нам на почту: navmateapp@gmail.com. Либо воспользуйтесь приложением cMate-APPS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cmate-apps-конвенция-плюс/id6502718737

Приложение для моряков особенно будет полезно судоводителям и студентам обучающимся на судоводительских факультетах. Также будет полезно и всем остальным чья работа или хобби связаны с морем.
Приложение содержит:
- Фразы ИМО (Стандартный морской разговорник для общения на море)
- Конвенция МАРПОЛ (Международная конвенция по предотвращению загрязнения с судов), с последними поправками 
- Флаги государств
- МППСС-72(Международные Правила Предупреждения Столкновений Судов)
- Описание системы МАМС (Международная ассоциация маячных служб)
- МСС (Международный свод сигналов) включает в себя сигнальные флаги, фонетический алфавит, азбуку морзе.
- Символы используемые на судах (Символы IMO)
- Сокращения используемые в прогнозах погоды (NAVTEX Inmarsat-C)
- Звуковые и световые сигналы МППСС-72 (Огни и знаки МППСС-72)
- Терминологический справочник судоводителя
- Большой морской словарь терминов и сокращений
- Различные языковые словари.
- Кодекс ЛСА (Международный кодекс по спасательным средствам 1-7 главы)
- Конвенция СОЛАС-74 (Международная конвенция по охране человеческой жизни на море 1974 года), Конвенция MLC (Конвенция о труде в морском судоходстве)
- Кодексы ISM, ISPS, FSS
- Раздел Ports Info содержит:
    - Название порта
    - UN/LOCODE
    - Страну 
    - Географические координаты
    - Позицию порта на карте мира
    - Краткое описание порта

Все базы данных доступны offline, опубликованы на Русском и Английском языках и оснащены удобным и быстрым поиском.

name: NetSpeed - Monitor de rede
description:
O NetSpeed mostra o estado da sua rede em tempo real: na tela bloqueada, na Dynamic Island ou em uma janela flutuante Picture in Picture. Assim você sempre sabe sua velocidade de download, de upload e sua latência sem interromper o que está fazendo.

Principais recursos:
· Monitoramento em tempo real das velocidades de download e upload
· Atividade ao vivo na tela bloqueada e na Dynamic Island
· Janela flutuante Picture in Picture, visível sobre qualquer app
· Teste de velocidade com um toque: download, upload e latência
· Gráfico com o histórico de velocidade dos últimos 60 segundos
· Detecção de redes Wi-Fi e móvel

Seja assistindo a uma série, jogando ou em uma videochamada, o NetSpeed ajuda você a perceber de imediato uma conexão lenta ou instável e a saber se o problema é a sua rede.

Requisitos:
· As Atividades ao Vivo exigem iOS 16.2 ou posterior
· A Dynamic Island exige um modelo de iPhone compatível
· O Picture in Picture exige iOS 15 ou posterior

name: Kit Manager
description:
O Kit Manager te dá controle total do seu Roland SPD-SX pelo Mac ou iPhone. Monte Kits, edite Waves, configure Pads, organize setlists e faça backup do aparelho inteiro.

Conecte o pad por USB e está tudo na sua frente: Kits, Waves, Kit Chains e configurações de sistema. Sem garimpar menu.

Kits e Pads

Crie Kits novos ou edite os que já existem. Renomeie, defina tempo e nível de saída, reordene slots, copie e cole para montar variações. Para cada um dos 25 Pads você tem o conjunto completo de parâmetros: atribuição de Wave, nível, panorâmica, modo de reprodução, saída MIDI, Link Pad. Tudo que o aparelho suporta, disposto de um jeito que dá para achar.

Biblioteca de Waves

Navegue por todas as Waves do seu SPD-SX, renomeie para algo que você realmente vá lembrar e apague as que só ocupam espaço. Exporte Waves direto do aparelho quando precisar delas em outro lugar.

Kit Chains

Monte as 8 Kit Chains com até 20 passos cada. Você vê nomes de Kit em vez de números de slot, então montar um setlist finalmente faz sentido. Arraste para reordenar, adicione e remova passos, ative e habilite chains na hora.

Backup e restauração

Faça backup de todo o seu SPD-SX em uma pasta no Mac ou iPhone. Restaure a partir de qualquer backup quando precisar voltar atrás ou levar sua configuração para outro aparelho. Você também pode abrir e editar um backup diretamente, configurando Kits, Kit Chains e ajustes de sistema sem o aparelho por perto, e restaurar quando estiver pronto.

Configurações de sistema

O SPD-SX tem muitos ajustes globais espalhados pelo sistema de menus. O Kit Manager coloca todos em uma única tela: display, MIDI, saída de áudio, foot switches, sensibilidade dos Pads, V-Link, metrônomo, Master FX. Mude o que precisar e siga em frente.

Modo demo

Longe do seu SPD-SX? O app vem com dados de exemplo para você explorar tudo antes de conectar.

name: St. Josemaria
description:
This application will help you live your Christian faith in your ordinary occupations and follow a personalized spiritual program with the hand of St. Josemaría.

Available in English, Spanish, German, Portuguese, French, Italian, Polish and Dutch

Includes the following:
• Books by St. Josemaria (The Way, Furrow, The Forge, Friends of God, Christ is Passing By, Conversations, Way of the Cross, love the Church and Holy Rosary). With a Chapter list and search capability.
• Novenas (Novena for Work, Novena for the Family, Novena For the sick, Novena for Forgiveness)

name: Sun Seeker - Tracker & Compass
description:
Sun Seeker is a comprehensive solar tracking & compass app. It shows the sun’s hourly direction intervals, its equinoxes, winter & summer solstice paths, sunrise & sunset times, twilight times, shadowed periods, UV Index, solar irradiance, golden and blue hours, eclipses & more. The app allows you to add sun-event notifications & has a widget and watch app showing the day’s solar data & position on an arc. The 3D View shows the solar direction for each sunlight hour. Sun Seeker has both a flat compass view & a 3D Augmented Reality (AR) view to show the solar position & path.

The app is useful for - 

▶ Photographers- to plan shoots according to the golden hour or blue hour & optimal sunlight conditions, sunrise & sunset times & directions.
▶ Cinematographers- enables you to find the solar exposure, directions, shadow, sunrise & sunset times for any location.
▶ Real Estate Buyers- can use the app before buying a property to check the sun's path & to find the solar exposure of properties.
▶ Drivers - Sun Seeker lets you track the sun path & movement during the days & helps drivers know the sun position to find how long the car will remain in the shade at any given parking spot.
▶ Campers & Picnickers- for anyone planning a day out, this app will help in finding where to camp, sit or pitch an umbrella depending on the sunlight & sun direction. 
▶ Gardeners- Sun Seeker can also help with finding optimal planting locations & seasonal sunlight hours as a sunrise calendar
▶ Architects & Surveyors- for visualising the spatial variability of the solar angle throughout the year & using the compass app as a sun surveyor & calendar to determine the sunlight directions.
 
Main Features
* Sun Seeker is a sun locator which uses GPS, magnetometer & gyroscope to find the correct solar position & sun path for your current location.
* Flat compass view shows current solar position, diurnal solar angle & elevation (separated into day & night segments), sun shadow length ratio, atmospheric path thickness.
* 3D augmented reality (AR) camera overlay view shows the sun's current position, and it's path with hour points marked. You can scroll through time to preview changes throughout the year or day, and an optional pointer to guide you towards the current location of the sun & help you find the sun's direction. 
* Map view shows solar direction arrows, sun path & elevations for each hour of the day.
* Choose any date to view sun position & path on that day. You can view sunset & sunrise times for each day as well.
* Choose any location on earth (includes 40,000+ cities or custom locations available offline, as well as a comprehensive online map search capability).
* Get additional details including sunrise, sunset & culmination times, maximum elevation, civil, nautical & astronomical twilight periods of the sun.
* Optional device notifications for all manner of sun-related periods & events, such as golden hour or blue hour, various twilight periods, or sun crossing a given compass heading or elevation.

The Sun Seeker app has been featured in numerous high-profile blogs, websites & publications, including Wall Street Journal, Washington Post, Sydney Morning Herald etc. "Truly amazing", "Incredible", "Brilliant - the most genuinely useful application of augmented reality - ever!"

Check out our YouTube video here: https://bit.ly/2Rf0CkO
Simply search YouTube for "Sun Seeker app" to find many videos, websites & blogs created by our enthusiastic users

FAQs
* See https://bit.ly/2FIPJq2 - also easily accessible from the app's info screen

Note
* The compass accuracy depends on having an undistorted magnetic field around your device. If you use it close to metallic objects or electrical equipment, directional accuracy may be impaired. The device’s compass accuracy can be optimised by calibrating it prior to use. See app’s FAQs for more help.

name: Flyskyhy
description:
Flyskyhy forms your flight instrument during flight and shows all information you need for that. You get the normal data like altitude, climb rate, ground speed, and glide angle. But it also calculates and shows the current wind direction and strength, very important for your safety.

A moving and rotating map shows your current flying position and flight trail. It indicates where you have gone up (in a thermal), and where you have had faster than normal decline. With that, you can easily find back that thermal that you lost. The map also shows the nearest known landing spots, and whether they are reachable by normal glide, given your current altitude and wind direction.

Integration with Bluetooth varios SensBox, FlyNet, GoFly iPico, XC-Tracer, BlueFlyVario, or SkyDrop gives accurate altitude and lift information. That turns your iPhone into an full-fletched GPS-vario, including vario tones.

The app makes a full log of your flight, that can be analyzed afterwards. Besides normal data like start and landing positions, duration of flight, and an altitude graph of the flight, Flyskyhy also calculates the scoring distances for you. So you can immediately see whether you have broken that FAI triangle record.

Your live location is reported on livetrack24.com or loctome.com if you desire, so anybody can follow your flight while it is happening. If you are flying together with friends, then their location is shown on your map during your flight. So you never have to wonder anymore whether they are in front of or behind you.

The flight display has multiple screens which are all fully configurable. You can move all elements to other spots, delete and add elements, and resize them.

Through in-app purchases, the app also supports airspaces and waypoints.

The app is optimised for paragliding and hang gliders, but can be used with all  kinds of airsports.

Main features during the flight;
• Altitude, climb rate, ground speed, air speed, direction, glide angle and many more
• Wind strength and direction
• Moving map of the flying area
• Spots where you have had lift, great for thermal coring
• Shows whether you can still reach a landing spot with the current altitude and wind
• Live tracking of your flight on livetrack24.com or loctome.com
• Shows live location of your friends during flight

After the flight:
• Full logbook of all your flights
• Basic flight data like start/landing, duration, height difference, distance flown, and many more
• Calculation of 5-points, open triangle, and FAI triangle distances
• Graph of altitude and climb rate
• Signed IGC and KML log files of flights
• Transfer the log to iTunes or send by email
• Upload the flight directly to XContest, ParaglidingForum, DHV-XC, and other Leonardo servers
• Open flight in Google Earth on the iPhone
• Replay the flight and relive it!

By purchasing the Waypoints Extension you get access to:
• A fully zoomable and scrollable map with the waypoints and optimised route. The map also shows start and landing spots, as well as restricted airspaces (with the Airspace Extension)
• Enter new waypoints, either on the map or by specifying the parameters
• Full route support with start time, goal, entry/exit points, etc. 
• Many instruments to guide you along the route
• Visible and audible indication when a waypoint has been reached
• Complete waypoints organiser
• Import and export of various waypoint file formats

By purchasing the Airspace Extension you get access to:
• Airspaces of 30 countries
• Display of airspaces on the map with configurable colors and formats
• Display of your vertical position w.r.t. airspaces
• Visible and audible warnings when approaching and entering an airspace
• Shows local airspaces by touching a spot on the map

Note: a live internet connection is required for live tracking of your and your friends locations
Note: continuous GPS and screen usage makes the battery drain faster than normal

Completely Rebuilt for 2026

New Dashboard

The best features from our beloved geolocation toolkit are back—see exactly how far you are from the next town or the nearest albergue.

Completely reimagined and interactive. Tap anywhere to see distances to points along your route. See where you are on the profile in real time. One complete elevation from start to finish, uninterrupted by page folds.

Offline and online versions of beautiful topographical maps. More interactive, more informative, more helpful when you're standing at a fork in the path. Offline map tiles now available as an in-app purchase—individually or as a bundle.

See active wildfires across Spain and Portugal, updated daily from the EU's Copernicus fire service (EFFIS), plus this season's burnt areas along your route. A quick safety check before you set out.

More Routes
Now includes the alternate beginning on the Aragonés and the alternate ending on the Invierno.

Smarter Updates
Over-the-air updates only download what's changed. No more full app downloads eating through your data plan.

Itinerary Planner
Built-in planner, with the ability to import your plan from wisepilgrim.com too.

Pilgrim Tips
Leave tips for pilgrims following behind you, and benefit from those left before you.

Accommodation Directory
A full directory of albergues, camping, hotels, pensions, paradors, and casas rurales. Over 900 in total, with special attention to those that can be booked online.

Stageless Guide
No more "stage anxiety" or guide-created bottlenecks.

Photos
Photos of albergues, monuments and other points of interest along the way. Currently 900+ images and growing.

Comments
Albergue closed early for the season? Have a restaurant to share, or one to warn others about? Every location gives you the opportunity to leave a comment and read comments left by others. No registration necessary.

Notes
Jot down a note on any town, albergue, or stop on the route, or drop a pin on the map for water, viewpoints, photo spots, or places to come back to. Everything gathers on one page in order along the Camino, ready to search and export. Your notes stay private on your phone.

Share & import — swap itineraries and notes with fellow pilgrims by QR code or file.
Back up your plan and notes to a file, so nothing's lost when you change phones.

¡Buen Camino and thank you for your support!

name: Game Mode Pro: Launcher & HUD
summary: Launch your games, watch live device readings, get a report after every session.
description:
Game Mode Pro is the paid edition of Game Mode: the same launcher and device-reading tools, its own interface, and no ads of any kind.

GAME LAUNCHER
Keep your games in one place. Apps that declare themselves as games are picked up automatically; anything else you add by hand. A home screen widget carries your most played game and the minute it usually dips.

LIVE HUD OVER YOUR GAME
With your permission, a small floating panel shows what Android reports while you play: free RAM, battery level and temperature, latency to a public DNS server, screen refresh rate. It does not show in-game FPS - no app can measure another app's frame rate - and it does not change how your game runs. Prefer no panel? Put one number in a screen corner instead.

REMINDERS WHILE YOU PLAY
Optional notifications, one of each per session: the minute your sessions with that game usually start to wobble, a hot battery, a low one, a phone already hot on the charger.

A REPORT AFTER EVERY SESSION
When you finish, the session's readings become a report: ping stability, free memory and battery temperature with the raw numbers beside each score, plus playing time. Every session is kept, and every game's play history is there to read.

AI GAME COACH - LEARNED FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
A model that runs entirely on your phone reads the sessions the HUD recorded: the minute your sessions with a game usually start to wobble, how long you can play before that, how long the battery lasts at that game's drain, and the time of day and network they held up best on. Behind it sit a risk-per-minute curve and a side-by-side of which game runs steadiest, gets hottest and drains fastest. Two recorded sessions of one game are enough for it to start. Nothing leaves your phone. These are predictions from your own history, not guarantees, and the app does not change your game or your device.

NETWORK CHECK
Twenty round-trip measurements to a public DNS server, one per second, with per-second bars, the average, the lowest, the variation and how many went unanswered. It measures your connection, it cannot change it, and never reaches a game's server.

GFX GUIDE
From your device's RAM, CPU cores, resolution and refresh rate, the app suggests a starting point for graphics, frame rate, resolution and shadows - settings you apply in the game yourself. The app cannot change a game's settings or make it run faster.

GAME MODE
Silences notifications while you play (your previous Do Not Disturb setting comes back afterwards) and, if you choose, calls too. It can also hold screen brightness where it is, set your media volume, keep the screen awake while Game HUD is on, and remind you to take a break. Auto Game Mode switches it on when a game opens and off when you leave. Everything it changes is restored when Game Mode ends; the brightness lock asks for "Modify system settings" with an explanation.

BEFORE YOU START
Opening a game from the launcher checks free memory, battery temperature and free storage against thresholds and names any reading outside them, instead of always saying "ready".

REFLEX TRAINER
Two short drills between matches: tap the instant the panel turns green, or hit twelve targets as fast as you can. Timed from the frame change to your touch - it measures you, not the device.

VIP (optional subscription)
Six things your recorded sessions make possible: a forecast of how the next session is likely to go; how much longer this game runs on the battery you have now; alerts that learn what is normal for your phone; how it has changed since your first sessions; a backup of your session log, so it survives a reinstall or a new phone; and your records with a weekly report. Everything else above is in the purchase price.

In 10 languages, switchable inside the app. Permissions: "Display over other apps" and "Usage access" are only needed for the HUD, and the app asks for them on the HUD screen with an explanation. Notification policy access is only for Game Mode's Do Not Disturb.

summary: Find, test and share your sensitivity, plus a live game HUD and on-device AI.
description:
Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play
• Suggests starting values — and prints every rule it used next to the numbers
Values are a guide you type into your game's own menu. The app never touches a game.

TEST & CALIBRATE
• Three short drills in the app: flick, track a moving ring, micro-adjust
• Measures overshooting, steadiness and precision and turns them into small per-row adjustments; also counts your touch sampling rate
• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES
• Profile slots: one free, three with VIP — every change saved automatically
• Templates that mirror each game's menu layout: Free Fire-style, PUBG / BGMI-style, COD Mobile-style and a generic layout
• Playstyle and game-mode presets for each template
• Share a profile as a code or QR and import a friend's — offline, no account
• Bind a profile to a game (VIP): launching that game from Sensi Pro selects it

GAME HUD
A floating panel with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges, thresholds printed beside them
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, the jitter band and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus (Do Not Disturb), keep-awake, dim, screenshot and screen recording, plus thermal status, battery, free RAM and throughput
• MY GAMES: your games one tap away, with the previous session's numbers
Drag it anywhere, shrink it to a ping bubble or close it. A REC line shows how much of the session is recorded.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: opens the HUD when a game from your list comes to the front and closes it after you leave — needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front
• Auto setup on launch: Focus, screen awake and dim, all undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game, both numbers shown

PRE-GAME TOOLS
• Device Scan: one tap measures live ping, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate into one report — it changes no setting
• Focus Mode: turns on Do Not Disturb for the match and lifts it when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• AI network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate the next latency and rate its stability
• AI Game Coach: add your games, launch them from Sensi Pro and get per-game insights — sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips; a detail screen shows what it learned
Both models run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested for your phone's RAM, cores and real refresh rates — you apply them in your game's own settings
• Home screen widget and per-game shortcuts: one tap opens the game with the HUD
• Break reminder, weekly play time and a report after each HUD session
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

VIP (optional subscription)
Auto HUD, auto setup, AI alerts, screen recording, the sensitivity converter (a profile onto another template or screen size), profile slots 2 and 3, per-game profiles and the AI Game Coach for unlimited games. Prices are shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD readout, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Template names only describe each game's own menu layout; game names are trademarks of their owners and this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game. removes the visual triggers that drive mindless phone checking — so picking

🚀 KEY FEATURES

  saves battery and reduces eye strain

  search and alphabet scroll

🧠 BUILT FOR
• Digital minimalists looking for a calmer, more intentional phone

  screen easier to focus with
• Anyone doing a digital detox or trying to cut phone/social media addiction
• Productivity-minded users who want to spend less time searching and more
  time doing

Download MINIMAA and start your digital detox today.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in

name: CNH do Brasil
summary: Digital driver's license and vehicle registration certificate, first driver's license, traffic violation and vehicle information.
description:
The Brazilian CNH app is the evolution of the Digital Traffic Wallet (CDT), which started as the Digital CNH. With the app, you can access your digital documents - National Driver's License (CNH) and Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) - in a practical and secure way, directly from your cell phone.

In addition, those who are not yet licensed can start the process of obtaining their First Driver's License through the app itself, making everything simpler and more accessible.

The Digital CNH and the Digital CRLV are the digital versions of the National Driver's License (CNH) and the Vehicle Registration and Licensing Certificate (CRLV) with the same legal value as their respective printed versions.

The digital versions offer additional advantages that provide greater mobility, practicality and convenience through:

- Ease of sharing information (export to PDF with digital signature in the ICP-Brasil standard with legal validity according to MP 2.200-2/2001). This avoids printing and/or scanning documents, as well as eliminating the need for notarization;

- Have your authenticity, reliability, and integrity easily validated through the Vio app. To do this, simply download the Vio app and point the reader at the QR Code of your digital document.

For more information, visit:

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

How to Play
- Find an arrow with a free path to the edge
- Tap to slide that arrow off the grid and open a lane for the next move
- Plan the order to secure a safe route and a clean board
- Long-Press to use Guidance to highlight directions when your path is unclear
- A wrong tap costs a heart for the level
- Clear the board to finish the level and aim for a perfect run
- Hints help focus when the grid feels tight
  
Why love this arrow puzzle
· Simple rules, profound strategy, and a meditative arrow puzzle
· Short breaks ease stress and sharpen focus
· The last arrow leaves the board with a satisfying mental reset
· Cognitive workout for sequencing and brain teasers
· Quiet visuals, plus a satisfying whoosh as each arrow flies off the grid — feedback that soothes instead of nags

Made for the in-between moments
- The ten minutes before a meeting starts 
- The metro ride too short for a podcast 
- The flight where your signal drops
- The wind-down after a noisy workday 
  
Amaze GO! - Puzzle Games is a calm arrow puzzle made for sharp minds and calm moments. Learn fast, then master timing and order. Send every arrow off the board, untangle the grid, and feel disorder turn into clarity. Amaze GO! is the puzzle you reach for when the rest of the day was too loud — one good move, then another, then a quiet board. Download now, plan smart paths, keep hearts safe, and enjoy pure focus anytime, anywhere!

name: Jam Bus:Sandfall
summary: A relaxing bus jam puzzle with sand layers, colors, and smart routes.
description:
Jam Bus: Sandfall brings a fresh twist to bus jam, color puzzle, and traffic escape gameplay.
Colorful sand is stacked in layers, and every bus has its own color and direction. Tap the right bus, collect the matching sand, and clear the board step by step. Sounds simple at first, but every move can change the whole puzzle.
Plan carefully before you tap. Some buses may block each other. Some paths may cross. Some sand colors can only be cleared after the lower layers are gone. To win, you need to observe the board, choose the right order, and keep every bus moving without a crash.
How to play
• Tap a bus to move it along its route
 • Match each bus with the same color sand
 • Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
 • Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
 • Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
 • Relaxing color-matching gameplay
 • Clever bus parking jam puzzles
 • Satisfying sand-clearing effects
 • Increasingly tricky routes and layers
 • Clean visuals and smooth puzzle flow
 • Great for quick breaks and brain training
Every level is a small logic challenge. A bus may look ready to move, but its route might block another vehicle. A color may be visible, but the sand below it must be cleared first. Think ahead, follow the arrows, and find the perfect order to clear the whole sandfall.
If you enjoy bus games, parking jam puzzles, color sort games, traffic escape challenges, or relaxing logic games, Jam Bus: Sandfall gives you a colorful new puzzle to solve.
Start with one bus, clear one color, and let the sand fall into place.

name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
summary: Millions of crafters have smashed billions of blocks! Now you can join the fun!
description:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting, and survival in the ultimate sandbox adventure. Gather resources, survive the night, and build a world one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, new and old. Build a block city, start a farm, mine deep underground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination in this expansive simulation!
 
Craft a new house, build a block city, or start a farm. Bring your imagination to life and build your dream avatar world where the possibilities are endless. Adventure through your own online game and play with friends, building from the ground up in our crafting simulation. In Creative mode, enjoy unlimited resources and the freedom of superior building and crafting. In Survival mode, survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer games with friends on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends and discover an infinite, randomly generated game 3D world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle) in a universe of crafting!
 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape!
 
BUILD YOUR DREAM WORLD
• Build a block city, a house, or create an entire game world from the ground up
• Building simulator games for kids, adults, or anyone
• Craft and build from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes
• Explore an endless open world simulation full of different biomes and creatures

• Private and community servers – Online village building game allows you to connect with millions of players, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server

• Add-ons – Block builders can customize their experience even further with add-ons as they build up! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your 3D game to create new resource packs
 
 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES
• Play with friends and other builders when you join our free massive multiplayer servers
• Multiplayer game servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account
• Explore endless realms through multiplayer games with friends. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you

name: Kingshot
summary: The Ultimate Medieval Strategy Idle Game!
description:
Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

name: Oxide: Survival Island
summary: Multiplayer survival simulator on abandoned island: survival action with friends
description:
Oxide: Survival Island is a hard online survival simulator. It is a sandbox world with real players. You wake up on a dangerous shore with nothing. This is island survival. Cold, hunger, animals, and enemies can kill you fast. Every server is a shared world. It keeps running even when you leave.

Play on your own servers. Your progress is saved. You can return later and continue. One server can host many players. That makes the world feel alive. You will meet builders, raiders, and clans. You can fight them or work with them. This is a true massively multiplayer survival experience. Many players look for rust survival vibes on mobile. This game gives that tense loop: gather, craft, build, defend, repeat.

Explore a big island of survival. Go through woods and coastal areas. Travel along the ocean and shore. Visit the gas station and enemy bases. Search loot barrels for supplies. The map is larger and more open. It gives you space to hide, scout, and attack. It also gives enemies more places to ambush you. Each run can feel like a lost island story.

You can play solo. You can also play with others. Try multiplayer survival games with friends. Invite them to the same server. Add them to your friends list. See when they are online. This makes teamwork simple. Build together and protect each other. That is co-op survival. If you like coop survival games, you can share roles. One player farms resources. One crafts weapons. One scouts and guards the base. These are coop survival games built by real players. For many fans, it feels like rust survival multiplayer, but designed for phones.

Collect wood, stone, and metal. Craft tools and gear. Craft weapons and ammo. The game has many weapon types. The crafting system is improved. The building system is improved too. Start with a small shelter. Turn it into a strong base. Place walls, doors, and storage. Create a safe area and defend it.

Use the cupboard system to protect your base. Craft a cupboard and place it inside. Put logs in it often. This slows down decay. It also helps you keep control of your home area. Without it, your house will weaken over time.

Survive in three biomes. Some zones are cold. Some are temperate. Some are hot. Craft attire for protection. Clothing helps against damage. It also helps against cold. Watch your food and water. Hunt animals for meat. Cook and store supplies. Manage your inventory and plan long trips.

Travel by land and by sea. The ocean is not only scenery. It is part of the danger and the route. Fans of sea adventure games will enjoy moving along the coast. You can scout bases from the water. You can move loot between points. The sea can also hide enemies. Storms and long routes add pressure. This is where island survival feels the most tense.

Fight for resources. Defend your base. Raid other bases. Make allies if you want. Betrayal is possible too. Each server becomes a contest for control. This is last survival. Only the strongest teams last. Master land survival, learn the map, and get better gear. Build smart, craft fast, and stay alert.

If you search for rust mobile, you want a tough survival sandbox on your phone. If you search for rust in mobile, you want raids, bases, and real players. Oxide brings that style with persistent servers, crafting, and open-world fights. It is a mobile answer for rust survival, with the freedom of a sandbox and the pressure of multiplayer survival.

Enjoy improved sky graphics and day-night changes. Watch the horizon, track threats, and survive the island.

name: Genshin Impact

description:

Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

name: Castle Busters
summary: Real-time 1v1 PvP strategy brawler. Smash castles, siege towers, rule arena!
description:
Castle Busters is a real-time 1v1 PvP strategy game where your castle is your weapon. Draft your units, blast through destructible walls, and crush rival players in fast online multiplayer battles.

No scripted waves. No waiting. Just you, your rival, and a castle that won't survive the match intact.

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.
Your castle isn't just your base, it's your weapon. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes an enemy. In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart in real time, and the player who reads it best wins.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Blast holes through walls to create firing lines and collapse floors to drop enemy units. No two PvP matches ever play out the same way.
⚡ Real-time 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions where every shot counts and every second of hesitation hands your rival a new opening.
🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft up to 8 unique units: knights, archers, bombers and siege engines. Each one changes how you attack, the angles you threaten, and how you defend your keep.
📈 Deep upgrades. Level up units, unlock new perks, and reinforce the parts of your castle that matter most. The longer you play, the sharper your arsenal gets.
🏆 Ranked arenas. Climb from Bronze to Legend and battle real players on seasonal leaderboards.
🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards by upgrading your squad and stronghold. The deeper you go, the meaner the meta gets.
🎯 Play your way. Precision snipes, brute-force sieges, decoy walls or collapse traps. Every strategy can win if you execute it right.

CORE GAMEPLAY
Aim and fire from inside your castle using your drafted units. The walls between you and your enemy aren't obstacles, they're opportunities. Destroy supports to collapse towers onto enemy positions. Carve a sightline through three floors to land a shot no one saw coming. Bait your opponent into breaking through where they shouldn't. In Castle Busters, defense is never passive. It's a trap.

Win by wiping out all enemy units, or by turning their castle into rubble. Arena hazards shift your angles and destructible terrain means every PvP battle is a puzzle that builds itself in real time.

DRAFT YOUR ARMY
Knights to break the front line. Archers to punish exposed units. Bombers to crack open walls and towers. Siege engines to flatten whole sections of an enemy castle. Mix and match up to 8 units into a loadout that fits your playstyle: patient and surgical, or fast and chaotic. Then upgrade each unit to unlock power spikes that open entirely new ways to play and clash.

META AND PROGRESSION
Your units grow with you. Level them up to unlock new perks, power spikes and fresh tactical options. Your castle evolves too. Reinforce the walls and towers that matter most, then test your build in multiplayer PvP. Ranked ladders and arenas introduce new obstacles, tighter matchups and fresh unit unlocks the deeper you climb. At the top of every leaderboard are players who have spent hundreds of hours perfecting their builds. You'll need to outthink them, not just outshoot them.

WHO IT'S FOR
If you love real-time strategy games, 1v1 PvP duels, tower-and-castle warfare, or fast online multiplayer battles you can finish in a few minutes, Castle Busters is built for you. Easy to pick up, hard to master, and impossible to play the same way twice.

BUILD. BREAK. REPEAT.

Flex City - The Ultimate Sandbox Driving and Racing Game Experience

Challenge yourself in the ultimate sandbox experience with Flex City, where the heart-pounding thrill of driving and racing games takes center stage. Advanced Shooting and Combat System:
